newsitem.title: UK: Barlows completes $10 mln stg of disposals.
newsitem.headline: Barlows completes $10 mln stg of disposals.

text.p: British property investment and development group Barlows Plc said on Wednesday it had completed the sale of six properties for 10.18 million stg.
Barlows said the disposals were in line with the company's strategy following its acquisition in May of real estate group Rowlinson Securities Plc for 43.6 million stg.
Four of the properties were acquired as part of Rowlinson and the other two part of Barlows' existing portfolio.
The disposals include Burleigh House in London and the Sherborne Hotel in Sherborne, Dorset.
"We are making good progress in reducing the group's borrowings in line with the plans outlined at the time of the acquisition (of Rowlinson's)," managing director Richard Fildes said in a statement.
Following the disposals, Barlows net debt has fallen from more than 59 million stg for just below 50 million.
